notes.title: The next Astral Dream Team video game is coming soon!
notes.notes:
[p]I’m WilliamsMyGL, an independent developer and creator of [b]VETITUM_VRC[/b] (also known as Astral Dream Team).[/p][p]I want to sincerely thank you for all the support you’ve given me throughout this journey. Thanks to you, I can continue creating and exploring new ideas.[/p][p]That’s why I’m excited to announce that on [b]August 20th, 2025[/b], I’ll be releasing my new game [b]for free[/b] on [i]Itch.io[/i]:[/p][p][b]An Ocean Game with The Eight Scurxs
[/b][/p][previewyoutube="DaQD5WNhqos;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s an absurd survival parody filled with humor and a very unique world, where you’ll explore different modes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Standard:[/b] The base mode with a balance between exploration and suspense.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardmode:[/b] More fog, less light, and a much more aggressive enemy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]50% Health:[/b] Start weaker for an extra challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VTuber Mode:[/b] A mode full of effects and unique references, paying homage to VTuber culture.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ocean Mansion:[/b] An experience that parodies classic horror with unexpected twists.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VETITUM_VRC Style:[/b] A special mode with nods for VETITUM_VRC fans.[/p][/*][/list][p]Although it’s an indie game, it contains small references for those familiar with my work, yet it can be enjoyed entirely on its own.[/p][p]Additionally, I want to share that we’re still working on the [b]VETITUM_VRC DLC[/b], titled [i]“Distorted Lamented Cries”[/i], which will bring new content and exciting updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/28c4059b4071d54c55ef5374fcb8a36b41d4c5d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for joining me on this creative journey! See you on [b]August 20th[/b] on [i]Itch.io[/i].[/p][p]— [b]WilliamsMyGL[/b] ([i]Astral Dream Team[/i])[/p]

notes.title: New DLC in production!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=O52mf6z3NIo;full][/previewyoutube]

VETITUM_VRC is back with a crucial piece of the story that was always hidden in plain sight. During the events of the first game, Leonard had a conversation with Oliver just days before his murder, recalling moments from his childhood and an unsettling connection to a mysterious film production. What seemed like a simple memory concealed the truth about his family and their ties to an influential producer, whose work turned out to be much more than just a movie.

In this new DLC, you will step into the shoes of a young Oliver, experiencing his perspective in a story that takes you back to the events of 1976. As you progress, you will uncover how an innocent-looking film production became the key to understanding a phenomenon that changed everything.

That fateful recording became a forbidden archive, a visual testimony of what truly happened when a mysterious meteorite crashed near the area. Every scene, every captured frame, hides clues about the events that followed and the far-reaching consequences for everyone involved.

What secrets were trapped in that footage? How deep does the truth behind that recording go?

Dive into this new chapter, relive Oliver’s memories, and uncover what was always there, waiting to be found.

notes.title: Upcoming updates on the way!
notes.notes:
The investigation will not end there!

In the coming months there will be updates for all our players where we will add more content and fix certain bugs that have happened to many of our players.

What will be new in the new updates?

- Subtitles added to videos and cinematics

- New configuration menu for the game

- 1 free DLC and 2 paid DLC

- Options to remove low audio quality filtering

- Text correction

- Implementing accessibility options for color blindness

- Free multiplier?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/75a412625705d6badc1b52d50707bb92a163681c.jpg[/img]
- More languages

- VR Edition

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/31115c47638538849aba06f11431c793e5e01e1d.jpg[/img]

All this new list will be added during the updates, this to give more immersion and more possibilities for many of our players can enjoy 100% to the comfort that you deserve.

More content for all of you, more ways to enjoy VETITUM_VRC

Our quest continues, do you think you will make it to the end?

notes.title: OFFICIAL RELEASE OF VETITUM_VRC
notes.notes:
VETITUM_VRC - Now Available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/d2337296f3a8c9cf3f042b7a9878264f4aaf5e7d.png[/img]


Immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere of VETITUM_VRC and explore a collection of videotapes containing multiple endings, each revealing fragments of a hidden story. In this game, nothing is what it seems, and you are part of the investigation.

Delve into the dark forest of Flemmywoods, where you will find clues to a mysterious event that someone is trying to cover up. In a chaotic night, secrets intertwine, and your mission will be to uncover the truth. Do you dare to solve the case with us?
